assets.label: Cultiste
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production sprite revision for Project RL, a grimdark futuristic/cyberpunk roguelike. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its identity, silhouette, pose, view, relative anatomy, existing equipment and material colors. Input image 2 is ONLY an already accepted finish reference, not the subject to copy. Match its matte worn game painting, broad readable shadow masses, believable material volumes, restrained irregular dark contours and localized wear. No glossy plastic, clean vector/cel shading, uniform thick black contours, new ornamentation or noisy microdetail. The final subject must stay readable at roughly 60 game pixels high, without increasing its relative world size. Same slightly elevated frontal sprite view as the target, no isometric or overhead redesign. Neutral diffuse overhead lighting. Render one WHOLE complete figure including all fingertips, weapons and soles, generous clear margins and a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No floor, scene, ground contact shadow, glow, aura, labels, words or border. Preserve the human cultist: dark charcoal hood with muted red inner edge, ivory closed angular mask, red chest/tabard and sleeve cuffs over dark practical trousers, gloves and boots. One small pale-metal pistol held in the extended hand to the left of the image. Keep the pistol straight, fingers wrapped around its grip, and empty other hand. No visible human face, no mutations.
